story: A 20-year-old man was found dead with injuries to his neck along Bagzane Street, N2 Gateway, Delft, on the morning of Sunday 4 October; police opened a murder case (police spokesperson Ndakhe Gwala, via Daily Voice and TygerBurger). The time of death and how he was injured were not given.
incident: Found Sun 4 Oct 2026, morning (time of death not given)
location_note: Bagzane Street, N2 Gateway, Delft (exact spot not given). The pin is on the street.
basis: Both reports rest on the same police statement; not independent confirmation.

provenance.note: Two reports written separately; the same two articles also cover the other Delft shooting. The shooting facts come from police spokesperson Const. Ndakhe Gwala in both. Daily Voice adds a resident and TygerBurger adds a DA spokesperson.
